mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 5.0% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met (interaction).
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (as measured by a rising GDP growth rate, GDPC1, over the past quarter), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% in the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units in a 3-month window, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has fallen below 1600 in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has fallen below 110.0 in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
